subject: MatrixISV integration — technical prerequisites & rollout checkpoints
messages:
From: Rohit Sharma <rohit@matrixisv.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@matrixisv.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@cloudmart.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MatrixISV x Redwood — onboarding prerequisites and timeline

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Matrix team is energized to move forward with a listing on Redwood's Marketplace and the private integration for our enterprise customers. Before we get to contract and listing content, our engineering team needs clarity on a few technical prerequisites so we can scope lift-and-shift for our managed customers. Can you confirm the following?

1) SSO / IAM: what SAML attributes does Redwood expect for scoped API access?
2) Private endpoint options: do we need VPC peering or can we use the Private deployment connector?
3) Model variant compatibility: can we call Redwood-hosted models with client-side keys or do calls need to route through Matrix's proxy?
4) Telemetry & billing hooks: what events should we instrument for attribution to Marketplace sales?

I understand some of this is infra-facing — looping in our lead engineer Samir and Elena (product) to keep the thread together.

Attachments: high-level ask list (mmp_v1_mutual_action_plan.xlsx)

Goal: have a short technical checklist and an agreed rollout window for pilot customers by next Tuesday (2026-09-22).

Cheers,
Rohit
Head of Partnerships, MatrixISV

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Rohit Sharma <rohit@matrixisv.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@matrixisv.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@cloudmart.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MatrixISV x Redwood — onboarding prerequisites and timeline

Thanks Rohit — great to see clear asks. Adding the internal owners below so we can split the checklist:

- Karthik (integration infra & SSO)
- Jonas (marketplace listing / entitlement)
- Vanessa (go-to-market / listing copy & commercial readiness)
- Ben (support & pilot ops)

Quick answers up front:
- SSO: Redwood supports SAML 2.0; we prefer NameID + email and recommend the attributes: email, givenName, familyName, groups. I’ll confirm exact attribute names with Karthik.
- Private connectivity: both VPC peering and our Private connector are supported; peering is faster but requires cloud ops coordination.
- Model calls: hosted model calls are per-customer API keys issued by Redwood; Matrix can either proxy requests or have customers call Redwood directly if Matrix wants no middle hop. There are pros/cons (latency vs auditability) — Karthik, please add recommended patterns.
- Telemetry: we publish marketplace attribution events; recommended events list in the attachment.

Immediate next steps I suggest:
1) Karthik to produce a one-page technical prerequisites doc (include SAML attributes, sample assertions, required firewall rules, TLS and cert notes).
2) Jonas to draft listing entitlement flow (trial entitlements, billing hooks).
3) Vanessa & Ben to outline pilot commercial terms and a simple support SLA for first 3 customers.
4) Rohit/Samir to confirm pilot customer list and any special requirements.

I’ll host a 45-min sync Thu morning to walk through the doc and unblock any gaps. Proposed time: Thu 2026-09-17 10:30am PT.

Thanks — Irene
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference

On attachments: please share your network diagram (if different from the attached architecture from our side).

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Rohit Sharma <rohit@matrixisv.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@matrixisv.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MatrixISV x Redwood — onboarding prerequisites and timeline

Hi all — I pulled together the technical checklist and attached a draft (sso_integration_steps.md and matrixisv_arch_diagram.pdf). Key engineering notes / constraints:

- SAML attributes: we require the following attribute names in assertion: 'email', 'first_name', 'last_name', 'groups'. Best practice: include org_id if you want mapping to Redwood account IDs.
- Private connectivity: for production pilot we recommend Private Connector (managed) unless Matrix customers already have peering expertise. Connector provides mTLS and reduces networking cutover.
- Keys & routing: we can support two patterns:
  * Customer->Redwood (recommended): customers hold API keys; Matrix receives attribution via marketplace events.
  * Matrix proxy: Matrix proxies auth and routing; this adds latency and extra KV cache concerns.
- Rate limits: for the pilot set RL at 30 requests/sec per customer; we can bump for Dedicated later.
- Data residency: if any pilot customer is EU, we need region pinning; otherwise US region is fine.

Open items for Matrix team to respond:
- Do you have an IdP that can surface org_id attribute?
- Which pilot customers need VPC peering vs Connector?

Attachments: matrixisv_arch_diagram.pdf (network sketch), sso_integration_steps.md (sample assertions)

Irene — I’ll join the sync on Thu.

Thanks,
Karthik
Staff Engineer, Integrations

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MatrixISV x Redwood — onboarding prerequisites and timeline

Team — commercial notes to keep in mind while we finalize the tech checklist:

- Listing copy: Matrix will need a short 2-3 sentence summary, 5 bullet product highlights, and a customer logo slot. We can supply a template.
- Pricing: recommend an initial marketplace listing with a 30-day trial entitlement and usage-based billing. Jonas, can you confirm entitlement implementation timeline?
- Marketplace SLAs: for pilot customers we can rely on standard Hosted SLA; if Matrix wants white-glove guarantees, we’ll need Dedicated or an add-on.
- Support: Ben, please confirm the handoff matrix for first-level support (Matrix handles app, Redwood handles infra).

Rohit — if you can share the proposed marketing launch window (week-of Oct 11?), we’ll align the listing and legal checkpoints. Also tagging Jonas for entitlement and billing hooks.

—Vanessa
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
